ARTON

Three light sources. One precise visual rhythm.

VISUAL IDEA

Design,
assembled in volume.

The elongated format follows the luminaire itself. Three directional spots create a rhythm, while a green band makes the product category easy to find.

Photography, pools of light and a dark background reveal the black housing and directional illumination. The dieline shows how information is distributed across the faces.
